description: Call this tool to write chosen events to a new .ics file you can send or import elsewhere. Pass either ids (from events_list) or a from/to window. Times are written in UTC so the file lands correctly in any client.

calendar.description: With from/to: limit to one calendar

ids.description: Event ids from events_list, events_search or next_event

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded .ics file, e.g. week.ics

name: event_export
title: Export events to a .ics file
